description:
Implement CLI commands for query plan analysis and ASCII visualization of
query plans. Includes compare-plans command for cross-platform/cross-run
comparison, and visualization utilities for rendering plans as ASCII trees
with side-by-side diffs.

**CLI Commands**:
- `benchbox run --capture-plans`: Capture plans during benchmark (already added)
- `benchbox compare-plans`: Compare plans from different runs/platforms
- `benchbox show-plan`: Display single plan as ASCII tree
